description: Run read-only ClickHouse SQL on selected websites in one organization. Use get_schema for table notes and include the website column to break results down by site. If you hit the organization limit, try again in a minute.

params.description: Values for {name:Type} placeholders. For one site, websiteId and websiteDomain are supplied for you.

sql.description: One SELECT or WITH query without comments, comma joins or table functions. Put values in {name:Type} placeholders.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

websiteIds.description: Website IDs from list_websites. Use this instead of a single website selector.

name: execute_sql_query

outputSchema.description: columns gives each result column's ClickHouse type. rows holds the first 100 rows that fit in 64 KB of JSON; list values keep the first 50 items and the row's truncatedArrays gives their full lengths. truncated is true when more rows existed than rows holds, and rowCount is then a lower bound, not a total: count with count(), aggregate, or add LIMIT, as hint says.

title: Run read-only SQL
